csv_project_name: As-Needed Engineering for Parent Drop-Off Improvements
csv_scope_of_work: Parent Drop-Off Improvements at Four Locations: Bethel Elementary School Bryson Elementary School Greenbrier Elementary School Skyland Elementary School Greenville County Schools (Owner) is soliciting professional engineering services for the design, permitting, bidding assistance, and construction administration of parent drop-off improvements at four elementary school campuses throughout Greenville County. The overall objective of this program is to improve parent pick-up and drop-off operations by increasing on-site vehicle storage capacity, improving internal traffic circulation, enhancing pedestrian safety, and implementing associated site improvements necessary to support the proposed work. Conceptual improvement exhibits for each campus have been prepared by the Owner and are included as attachments to assist Consultants in understanding the general intent of each project. Consultants shall independently evaluate each site and develop the engineering approach necessary to complete the required professional services.
